title: Permits and Old-Material Haul-Away on Ridgeline Installation Services Jobs
content:
## Permits

Whether a Ridgeline Installation Services job needs a permit is recorded at the measure. When it does, Ridgeline pulls the permit, and the permit status moves from required (pending) to issued when the permit office issues it.

On a program that passes the permit fee through, the municipal permit fee recorded on the contract is billed at cost as one permit fee line. No permit fee lines post for a job that needs no permit.

> And the program's permit handling fee as a permit handling fee line, both on the date the permit is issued — this clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the permit handling fee.

| Permit facts (hypothetical) | Permit fee line |
|---|---|
| Job needs no permit | none |
| Permit required, still pending | none yet |
| Permit issued, program passes the fee through, municipal fee 180.00 | one permit fee line of 180.00, at cost |
| Permit issued, program does not pass the fee through | none |

## Removal and disposal of the old material

Removal and disposal of the old material is part of the contract price on a program that includes haul-away. On a program that does not include it, the program's haul-away fee is billed as one haul-away fee line on the installation date when the customer chose removal.

| Program includes haul-away | Customer chose removal | Haul-away fee line |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | none; removal is in the contract price |
| no | yes | the program's haul-away fee, on the installation date |
| no | no | none |
